content: MK reads Bākharzī's account as 'king-of-the-hill' tendentiousness: elements of the later Naqshbandiyya, Jāmī foremost, consolidated their ascendancy by distancing themselves from the more intellectual and suspect project of the Isfahan Circle. In MK's paraphrase of the account's implied line, the circle was unfairly persecuted but wrote inexpertly, may have deserved the accusations of heterodoxy, and were failed Sufis dependent on court patronage.
